c673cd21-28f9-43fe-9ff2-ad540fbc3ac1.title: Lanthus
c673cd21-28f9-43fe-9ff2-ad540fbc3ac1.text: Good day, how may I help you?

options.text: What is this place?
What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
I don't want to gain experience in the arena.
I'd like to gain experience in the arena again.
Is there something I can do with these bracelets?
How many bracelet charges do I have stored?
Can I stop using my stored bracelet charges?
I'd like to use my stored bracelet charges again.

ed1b5f2f-8c41-43f3-9a11-1387cea58a90.title: Lanthus
ed1b5f2f-8c41-43f3-9a11-1387cea58a90.text:
This is the great Castle Wars arena! Here you can
fight for the glory of Saradomin or Zamorak.

options.text: Really, how do I do that?
What can I win?
What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!

bb7c159c-e978-4476-9917-2722544a17f5.title: <player>
bb7c159c-e978-4476-9917-2722544a17f5.text: Really, how do I do that?

2ec447e9-20aa-43e7-a896-2123802408c0.title: Lanthus
2ec447e9-20aa-43e7-a896-2123802408c0.text:
Easy, you just step through one of the three portals.
To join Zamorak, pass through the red portal. To join
Saradomin, pass through the blue portal. If you don't
mind then pass through the green portal.

options.text: Are there any rules?
What can I win?
What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!

520415e4-ec2d-4170-b409-0893ca53630c.title: Lanthus
520415e4-ec2d-4170-b409-0893ca53630c.text:
Of course, there are always rules. Firstly you can't
wear a cape as you enter the portal, you'll be given
your team colours to wear while in the arena. You're
also prohibited from taking non-combat related items in

6c946a39-6ef6-43ba-9469-24d8dd166387.title: Lanthus
6c946a39-6ef6-43ba-9469-24d8dd166387.text:
with you. So you should only have equipment, potions,
and runes on you.
Secondly, attacking your own team or your team's
defences isn't allowed. You don't want to be angering

35acd79b-39d4-4bf2-8839-033265dde3cd.title: Lanthus
35acd79b-39d4-4bf2-8839-033265dde3cd.text:
your patron god, do you? Other than that, just have
fun and enjoy it!

1b3538e1-bcc4-439c-915f-9b462be44c84.title: <player>
1b3538e1-bcc4-439c-915f-9b462be44c84.text: Great! Oh, how do I win the game?

11415f2c-fda1-455e-b60b-04ba2fff38d8.title: Lanthus
11415f2c-fda1-455e-b60b-04ba2fff38d8.text:
The aim is to get into your opponents' castle and take
their team standard. Then bring that back and capture
it on your team's standard.

options.text: What can I win?
What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!

d1879e51-3552-4915-b0ba-169a4b614894.title: Lanthus
d1879e51-3552-4915-b0ba-169a4b614894.text:
Players on the winning team will receive 2 Castle Wars
Tickets, or 3 if the other team never scores, which
you can trade back to me for other items. The losing
team and both teams in a draw get at least 1 ticket.

options.text: Are there any rules?
What do you have for trade?
Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!

90504cfb-3b0e-4107-9cb8-adbef8e93c89.title: <player>
90504cfb-3b0e-4107-9cb8-adbef8e93c89.text: Do you have a manual? I'd like to learn how to play!
